house.name: Whittaker House
house.theme: Abandoned Victorian horror house with dark, claustrophobic rooms and unsettling details.

floors.name: Top Floor
floors.description: A narrow, attic-like floor with low ceilings, long shadows, and a sense of things watching from above.

rooms.name: Attic Loft
rooms.description: A cramped room filled with dusty trunks, broken dolls, and warped portraits. Pale moonlight spills through a single cracked window.

rooms.name: Storage Closet
rooms.description: A tiny closet lined with brittle boxes and forgotten household items. Each step kicks up a cloud of powdery dust.

rooms.name: Guest Bedroom
rooms.description: A cold bedroom with a single bed and an old wardrobe. The sheets move as though something beneath them breathes.

rooms.name: Top Bathroom
rooms.description: A small bathroom where the mirror is cracked and the faucet drips in a slow, irregular rhythm.

rooms.name: Top Floor Landing
rooms.description: A narrow landing with peeling wallpaper, leading to every room on the top floor.

floors.name: Ground Floor
floors.description: The main living level is large and cold, with a foyer that feels like the center of a nightmare.

rooms.name: Foyer
rooms.description: A wide foyer with a chandelier hanging at an angle and a grand staircase leading both upstairs and down.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.description: A dim room with sagging furniture, a cold fireplace, and the smell of incense lingering in the air.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.description: A long table set for a meal that never happened. Plates are dusty and chairs are pulled out as if guests have just left.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: A decrepit kitchen with rusty appliances and a refrigerator that hums despite being unplugged.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.description: A dark study filled with bookshelves, a heavy desk, and a half-burned candle that still flickers.

rooms.name: Pantry
rooms.description: A cramped pantry stocked with rotting jars and the faint smell of ammonia.

rooms.name: Stairs to Top Floor
rooms.description: A creaking staircase wrapped in shadows, leading up to the top floor.

rooms.name: Stairs to Basement
rooms.description: A narrow, steep stairwell descending into the basement, where the air grows colder with each step.

floors.name: Basement
floors.description: A dark, damp basement full of old machinery, hidden spaces, and the feeling that something lives beneath the floor.

rooms.name: Basement Landing
rooms.description: A low, damp landing at the bottom of the stairs with pipes running along the ceiling.

rooms.name: Boiler Room
rooms.description: A room dominated by a large boiler that emits a low thrum and occasional bursts of steam.

rooms.name: Cellar
rooms.description: A cold cellar lined with shelves of dusty jars and a wooden crate tucked in the corner.

rooms.name: Laundry Room
rooms.description: A damp laundry room with a broken washing machine and the smell of bleach mixed with damp fabric.

rooms.name: Hidden Room
rooms.description: A concealed room behind a false wall, still furnished as if someone left in a hurry.

notes: Use the top floor for tense exploration and hidden secrets.
Make the ground floor feel like the main atmospheric hub with multiple branching paths.
The basement should be the darkest, most oppressive area with the strongest horror beats.
Scatter clues and interactive objects across floors to encourage exploration.
